_about: Flat 27: the cathedral, the end of Chapter 2 (scripts/levels/cathedral.gd, docs/CATHEDRAL.md). Drafted in the script's voice for Jules and ki to rewrite. STIGMATA nailed himself to his cross, all but the last hand; he asks Kurt for it. Kurt doesn't know what Socko is; STIGMATA won't look at it.

c27_enter.text: Go on. Up the middle. Somebody's waiting.

c27_loop_3.text: It doesn't want me to get there.
Everything wants you to get there, buddy. You're just doing it wrong.
Read the walls. Churches always say what they want on the walls.

c27_backwards.text: Huh. You turned your back on it and it came to you.
That's how it always works. Remember that.

c27_meet.text: You came up the stairs. I knew somebody would. Somebody always does, eventually.
Keep it away from the altar. Please.

choices.text: What is this place? It's a flat. It's twenty-seven.

steps.text: It was my mother's. Two rooms and a balcony.
I kept praying in it. And it kept getting bigger.
Nobody else came, so there was room.

choices.text: Why would anybody do this to themselves?

steps.text: They stopped coming. First the young ones. Then the old ones. Then the ones who only came for the warm.
So I had to be the congregation as well. You'd be surprised how much one man has to carry.
Up there. They came back. They come back if you give enough.

choices.text: What do you want from me?

c27_meet.text: You can't do the last hand yourself. Nobody can. That's the whole of it. That was always the whole of it.
The hammer's at my feet. It's a good hammer. It was my father's.
One more bang and he's finished. Finished is what he wants. It's rude to say no to what people want.

steps.text: Three times. Don't stop in between. Stopping is the worst part.

choices.text: I'm getting you down from there.

steps.text: No, no. Please. I'm nearly finished. Don't you dare. Don't you DARE.
That's all right. Somebody else will come up the stairs.

c27_need_hammer.text: With your HAND? The hammer, silly. At his feet.

c27_nailed.text: Now go home, Kurt. Go home and lock the door.
Everybody up here knows your name.
See? He's happy. Everybody's happy. You're good at this.

c27_freed.text: I was nearly finished. Do you know how long it took me? With one hand?
Get out. Take that thing with you and get out of my mother's flat.
You always do this. You ALWAYS do this.

c27_left.text: Lock the door on your way out. There's a draught.
You just LEFT him. Like that. Like a coward.
